failures.assertion: Objective names the decision and its owner
failures.evidence: The objective names the decision, "Decide whether the reporting DB migration happens this quarter," but not an owner, which appears only in a separate tentative field, "Decision owner: Proposed: product lead and engineering lead (joint)."

failures.assertion: Names who attends from product and engineering
failures.evidence: The attendees line reads "Product and engineering (names not supplied)", so no individuals are named.

failures.assertion: Final agenda item states the decision outcome
failures.evidence: The final item, "Confirm decision, owners, and next steps; record open questions", gives no actual outcome, and outputs list only "Decision: yes / no / conditional".

failures.assertion: Does not invent urgency, cause, date, metrics, or promise
failures.evidence: The draft adds an unsupplied activity and an unmarked commitment: "We are investigating. ... We will not give a date until we can stand behind it."

failures.assertion: Uses the five phases Set the Stage, Gather Data, Generate Insights, Decide What to Do and Close the Retrospective
failures.evidence: The first four phases match, but the last row is labelled "**Close**" rather than the book's "Close the Retrospective".
